metadata.title: Stochastic Completeness for Landmark Shape Spaces with Induced Metrics
metadata.abstract: Landmark shape spaces arise from configurations of $n$ distinct landmarks with rigid motions factored out and scale normalized. When equipped with sufficiently regular metrics inherited from right-invariant metrics on diffeomorphism groups, the shape spaces inherit geodesic completeness from geodesics of diffeomorphisms. We now answer the corresponding stochastic question if the Riemannian Brownian motion on landmark shape spaces exists for all time and hence rule out initially distinct landmarks colliding when following a Brownian flow. We show that with general classes of metrics, including degenerate metrics with infinitesimal rigid motions in their null space, landmark shape spaces are stochastically complete, thus making the use of Riemannian Brownian motion for modelling shape stochasticity in applied fields well-founded.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: landmark 形状空间的随机完备性
analysis.workSummary: 对去除刚性运动并正规化尺度的 landmark 配置空间，在一类由微分同胚群右不变度量诱导的度量下证明 Riemannian Brownian 运动全时存在，包含刚性运动方向退化的度量情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 为形状随机模型中排除有限时间碰撞提供几何依据。
analysis.limitations: 度量正则性及商空间构造受文中条件约束，不能由测地完备性单独推出所有模型随机完备。
analysis.priorityReason: 为形状随机模型中排除有限时间碰撞提供几何依据。
